reviews.text: Amazing groomer for a fair price

This place is absolutely amazing! 🥹❤️ My girl Gece had her very first grooming appointment here, and I couldn’t be happier! Everyone was so loving, gentle, and attentive. She looked so relaxed and comfortable when I picked her up, which meant everything to me! You can definitely trust them with your fur babies. It’s worth every penny! The adorable Halloween-themed touches were such a sweet surprise, too! 🎃🐾 Thank you so much for taking such great care of Gece. You’ve officially become our go-to grooming place! We’ll definitely be back! ❤️
Booked a last minute same day appt for my two dogs. First time at this salon but definitely not my last. The staff did an amazing cut and were so kind to the pups. :)🥰💖

The best!! They really care about your baby and handle them with such care. They are professional and very informative. I specifically love that they have a glass wall to watch any service being done. My regular spot!

My corgi Pippa and I LOVE Fluffy Pet Grooming!!!! Irene and Gary are excellent with both the dogs and the dog parents. They listen to what you want for your dog and explain if anything is not a good idea or perhaps how to address any issues. They respond quickly to phone calls and emails and seem truly happy to be doing what they're doing. They take time with your dog and show kindness and compassion with each animal. They're knowledgeable about all aspects of Grooming. We'll be clients forever!
Kristi F.
Nail cutting. My little dog is feisty and they did a wonderful job!

Highly recommend this small biz! We dropped off our three big boys with Fluffy and couldn’t be happier with the results. They each came back looking amazing, and the staff were all so kind & knowledgeable. They took their time with our pups and spoke with us at length beforehand to set expectations. You can definitely tell their passion for taking care of your fur babies. And pricing was very reasonable! Happy to say we’ve found a new groomer business in Oak Cliff!
This place is like a gold mine. Wonderful owner. Took me a couple of months to get in. But my fault. For me, and my lhasa apso, heaven.

We took our two Golden Retrievers, Buddy and Enzo, in for grooming, and the service was absolutely spectacular!
You can truly tell that they care about the pets and treat them with so much love and attention. We couldn’t be happier with how everything went!

We will definitely be back! 10/10 service!

Thank you so much for taking such great care of Buddy and Enzo

First time bringing my furry baby here and we loved it. They book your appointment same day and the facility members are very nice and friendly . They explain to you the process and give you options on haircuts and length. Definitely recommend, my furry baby feels brand new .

Fluffy Pet Grooming did an amazing job with Bentley! He went in for a full grooming, and we couldn’t be happier with how he came out. He looked fresh, clean, and absolutely adorable! The attention to detail and care they gave him really stood out.

Thank you, Fluffy Pet Grooming, for taking such great care of Bentley. We’ll definitely be back! 🐾❤️

This place was recommended to me by a friend from the dog park. Their availability is very flexible and the price is budget friendly. Everyone was so welcoming and nice. They were informative when asking what I was wanting. They were super fast with the grooming but my pup turned out to be fantastic! Very happy and will return!

AMAZING EXPERIENCE!!! This was my first time going to this groomer and they were so amazing, friendly and accommodating. While we waited they educated us a little bit about dog grooming and where to get low cost vaccines for my pup. They have a glass partition so you could see exactly what is happening with your dog which is a really huge plus! They are also very reasonably priced! I will definitely be back!

They were very friendly and welcoming! This was the first time I saw my chihuahua be so calm without being stressed, unlike other pet grooming places. They also have very good prices. I definitely recommend to others to bring your pet here!

I brought my dog Eevee here to get her nails trimmed and it was a fantastic experience! Eevee had never been to a groomer before and I was probably more nervous about the whole process than she was… but everyone at Fluffy Pet Grooming made us both feel super comfortable! They were able to trim and dremel all of her nails, even her very overgrown dew claw that the vet couldn’t manage to clip. And Eevee has some reactivity to other dogs on leash, but that wasn’t a problem at all. They did a good job keeping her distracted and calm and she didn’t even bark once! We will be back!!!
They made getting my corgi groomed quick and easy and they were so friendly! They are now my regular groomers for him.

Came from out of town with our little Yorkie Luke. He was so scruffy and in need of a groom. Fluffy Pets was nearby and had availability. I was so pleased with his final result. The groomer did a great job. Luke turned put so handsome and clean. 🐾

Yes, yes, yes....yes!!! Thank you so much for such a great experience.

First time grooming for our new puppy and the staff were very friendly and relaxing. Honestly, I was more stressed than the puppy. He no longer looks like he has been living on the streets for the last 6 months. And the best thing, even though I know it was stressful at times for him, when we picked him up he was happy and relaxed and continued to engage with the staff. Truly seemed like he had a good experience and that can only happen if the staff are truly loving and caring.

Thank you again. Can't wait to come back!!

Go support your local businesses Oak Cliff!

Such kind and gentle dog groomers. They took excellent care of my elderly dog who is usually very anxious at the groomer. Gary and Irene put my dog at ease, and he remained calm for his entire grooming. The shop is incredibly clean and professional. I highly recommend!
I'm thrilled with the girl and the haircut looks amazing on my teddy! 🤩😍❤️ I'll definitely contact them again. …
Amazing job! I have never seen Brody’s coat so shiny after a groom. He looks and smells amazing! We will be back. Thank you!

Took my Pomeranian this week and was very happy with the service, how quick and communicative they were, the care they took, how transparent they were, etc. Will definitely be coming back. I’m always nervous to leave my dog with someone but they made me feel very comfortable!
Always leaves our pets looking spectacular ❤️😎 They are really nice!

We’ve been coming here since they first opened, and they’ve taken care of all 4 of our family pets. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and truly feels like family. We especially appreciate their house-call grooming option because one of our dogs has a heart murmur, and keeping him calm and comfortable is so important. They are always patient, gentle, and compassionate with him, which gives us such peace of mind. Every visit has been a wonderful experience, and our pets always look amazing afterward. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy groomer.
Very friendly and to be honest my dog wasn't crying when we got there. I guess he was comfortable. His grooming was great..no complaints. Jojo was "clean cut" and I will be back.

I took my 16yr old Schnauzer with anxiety here and they did amazing with him! The staff was so gentle, kind, and attentive with him. They make sure vaccines are up to date and ask questions to get the haircut just right. He had gone to the vet a couple of days before and had some hair clipped there for medical reasons but they were able to even it out perfectly. The setting is also intimate and you can watch them groom dogs. I will definitely be returning here.
Nayru really enjoyed it. it was her first time! I was a bit worried since she’s only 4 months old, but they were incredibly kind and made sure she felt safe and loved.

Amazing experience! Blocks from my house in a really convenient part of Oak Cliff. Owner is so nice and welcoming. Very clean. She took her time with my dog and I have a goldendoodle, which sometimes takes extra time! Will definitely be back, so excited to find this little gem by my house 💖

Great customer service. Took my mom’s dog for a nail clipping and the lady did a great job.
Will definitely be back for more sessions.
I love the service and prices!

Please please please support this business. Very reasonable prices and such a positive experience from my dog to mine. The owners were patient and very knowledgeable. They took care of my dog better than PetSmart and as if she was their family. I highly recommend them to anyone anytime. My dog was matted and needed TLC and that’s what they gave her with a full groom.

They did a great job with my dog! I got a next day appointment which was super convenient. They are fairly priced and I appreciate the glass doors so you can see their grooming. The staff are kind and attentive.

I will be bringing him back here!

I was so surprised they did a beautiful great job on my blue yorkie Max 5yrs. They did not use drugs or anything else Max was heard to deal with but with Fluffy Pet was so respected fast service truly he loved it.  And so did I.
Fluffy pet grooming did a fantastic job! Not only are they great at grooming, they clearly care about dogs and thanked me for adopting. We will be returning for his regular grooms!

This was my first time taking my dog anywhere to get groomed. I was always scared to leave her with strangers. I did my research and found this place. I absolutely loved this place. Everyone was so friendly and they did such a wonderful job on my Lola Bear.
Went in for a full grooming appointment and it was fantastic.
Absolutely loved it there. First time getting Deebo groomed here and they did a fantastic job! Found my new groomer!
Wonderful service! Each time I take my boys they come home all happy! We are always excited to go back!!

I have been taking my Havanese (Jazz) to Donna since I rescued her a couple of years ago from a puppy mill.  Donna takes SUCH good care of my senior girl who has no teeth, hard of hearing and now blind.  I am so glad she found Flufly Pet Grooming!  This place is great!!  The owners and staff are all so sweet and knowledgeable.  The space is clean and all the dogs look so happy during their visit!  I needed Jazz groomed for the holidays and Donna did a fabulous job cleaning her up in all the right places and she almost looks like a puppy again!  The extra touch of Christmas ribbons on her head are icing on the cake!  Thanks Donna and Fluffy Pet!!

Best grooming experience I have ever had! They are very accommodating and very nice.  My dogs loved it there and they came home looking very handsome and fluffy! Definitely recommend Fluffy Pet Grooming
I’ve been taking my dog, Cheeto, since I found out about it. Best groomer in Oak Cliff!  The staff always make themselves available and the grooming is always top tier!
We love this place. Owner is amazing!  Great pricing. Highly recommend!
I took my chihuahua to get her nails trimmed, and the staff was incredibly kind and professional. They made the whole experience easy and stress-free. I highly recommend them.

If you want your pet magazine ready, this is the place! Fluffy’s  exceptional customer service, ability to connect with your pet and  their unmatched grooming skills, allows for the absolute best pet grooming experience!
My fur baby pooches enjoyed their spa/groom day! We love Fluffy Pet Grooming! They always do an amazing job! My babies needed a well overdue cut & bath & Fluffy Pet Grooming did not disappoint!
First visit today. Amazing!!! Owners are amazing. The groomer Donna did an amazing job. The owner is so knowledgeable and makes you feel comfortable and welcomed. Price was amazing.
They did an amazing job on Ruby. First time going there and they were very thorough.

Omg!!!!! Super excited with the outcome of my babies grooming today! I called in explained how PetSmarts, screwed one of my babies up and she told me to stop by to let her see. And she truly worked her magic on my baby Jax! And even squeezed my little Roscoe in. Thanks again!!! Definitely a new client!
Found this place and won’t take my dog anywhere else! They do a great job at a great price!
They did an excellent job they are very gentle with nice with the dogs i recommend for any dog size ❤️
I didn't like anything they did to my dog. I told them to give her a teddy cut and they gave her back to me looking like a horrible mouse. I'm never taking her to that place again.

I highly recommend Fluffy Dog Grooming. The staff is professional, patient, kind, and communicates very well. We take our English Bulldog there due to her shedding; they even took the time to educate me on how they would groom her breed. I greatly appreciated it.
Irene and her team are amazing! Got me in last minute and did such a great job. She definitely has a new customer for life!
They always do an amazing job with Luki! He loves coming here and seeing his favorite groomer Claudia!
Wonderful place and they’re very good at what they do ❤️
Took our little pitbull "Mishu" to get her bathed, groomed and her nails done. We were warmly greeted by the owner with an expert eye for what our dog needed.
Took my dogs get nails cut they took good care of them I’ll definitely come back 100%
My beautiful Michael always gets a great makeover…
My dog love coming here and they always take care of my dog here they do amazing work would Heights recommend this place.

My dog (lily) absolutely loves her groomer!!! They handled her with so much patience. She has been there multiple. I watched them handle multiple dogs with love and they clean their tables  and cage after every use. I highly recommend fluffy pet grooming!!!

0 Stars for this Grooming place, Few months ago i took my puppy there and i’ve seen she has dogs all over running around the place not caged up or anything This how they catches virus. After my puppy came back home started feeling bad. diarrhea everywhere and throwing up. I had to call her because my pet was acting normal before and after i took her brought her home started feeling sick like what…? I Do not recommend at all coming here with your pets. Such A dirty place!!!
Love the ability to see our dogs get groomed. The staff is always friendly and very knowledgeable. My dogs are always happy and looking great at pick up.

This was the third time I brought my dog here. The first two visits were great, his haircut was even and well done, which is why I felt comfortable coming back. Unfortunately, this time was a completely different experience.
There seem to be new groomers, and my dog’s haircut looks extremely uneven and poorly done. He honestly looks butchered compared to previous visits. Toward the end of the appointment, I was told that he was trying to bite, which I understand can make grooming difficult. However, I really wish this had been communicated earlier. If they were unable to safely or properly complete the haircut, I would have preferred to be told upfront rather than paying full price for a rushed and uneven result.
I’m disappointed because I’ve had good experiences here before, but this visit fell far below expectations.
Irene & Donna are always great with the family pets!!!
I never knew they were close to home. Management is awesome and Donna is great with all dogs especially with my Chica

Donna is back! We used to go to Donna’s Soggy Doggie and now she’s here at Fluffy’s doing the same great job.  The service is great, pricing is standard and our Bernedoodle was done in record time.   We will be back, thanks again!

Love this place! The groomers are polite, professional and patient with your pets. The environment is clean and friendly, I especially love the glass wall that divides the work station and waiting area, as it provides comfort and reassurance for my pet and I. Very affordable!

First grooming experience for our newly adopted dog. As first time dog owners we couldn't have asked for a better experience. The groomers did an amazing job! We felt so at ease and Irene did a wonderful job of answering an questions we had. Our dog was so comfortable there and he looked  great! Would recommend!
They did an awesome job on my baby. Thanks again!
Awesome  grooming & clean place and friendly I highly recommend this establishment!
Awesome staff and great location. I have been there several times. Irene and her staff are warm and friendly.
Awesome pet grooming! Store is clean and staff is very friendly. 3rd visit so far. Couldn't recommend enough! My dog Kamila loves them too!

My dog is very anxious and I stopped by Fluffy Pet Grooming first to see their space and talk to them as they had been recommended.  Their operation is very transparent thanks to a huge window which lets you see every step of the grooming session.  After talking to Irene, I felt much better to bring my dog.  They were amazing on how they approach Akar (an Aussie Doodle), Irene took her time and let Akar get comfortable with her handling.  I was impressed with their understanding of each dog's situation, their willingness to treat Akar as an individual, not just another dog to get done that day!  I might even say that Irene is a dog whisperer.

I’m so happy I found this place. Not only is it so much closer to home, my dog was in desperate need of a grooming after a last minute cancellation from elsewhere and they were able to fit her in last minute. My dog is scared of everything and everyone she meets, but she was so calm when I picked her up. You can definitely tell they care when it comes to their furry customers.  Price is extremely reasonable as well. We hope to be back soon!

Amazing groomers! They are so friendly and took the time to ask questions about my dog Bella's cut, and even offered suggestions for vet services in the area. I had showed them a picture of what I was  looking for and they far exceeded my expectations. They really know what they're doing here and their prices can't be beat. Other places wanted me to charge me $120+ for my tiny 6lb dog, wild. Come here if you want truly skilled groomers that genuinely care about what they're doing! Thank you Fluffy Pet! ❤️
Irene, Lisa, and Donna are great. Very thorough with their notes with new customer to ensure your pet receives the best care. My doggy received the cutest groom. Very happy with my service.
You can tell that the owners really enjoy what they do and care about our furry babies.

This place is amazing, very clean and reasonably priced.
My dog Angel was returned looking and smelling incredible.
The staff of Irene and Lisa went beyond expectations.
It was my first visit but certainly not the last. Thank you!!!

First time at Fluffy Pet Grooming today and although there was a small hiccup in my scheduled appointment they honored the appointment and my time and took in my dog for full grooming. They are so very professional, informative and highly skilled. My dog can be anxious and squirmy but they handled him with care and patience and did an amazing job! I’m very picky on where I take my dog and will definitely be back. I highly recommend Fluffy Pet Grooming for your fur babies.
Treated Cody and Speckles like royalty. Cody has never looked so good!
I’ll be bringing my pup back they did a good job and he seemed happy

YES.

They’re amazing here
Extensive knowledge and care for your fur baby
Highly recommend
Staff is friendly and professional. My dog looks great! The area inside is clean and comfortable.
Best groomers in Dallas if you’re not going to fluffy’s pet grooming, you’re doing your dog a real disservice the best cut my puppies Iever had
Best service and advice ever, left my puppy so great and looking like a stud muffin
10/10 loved it !!!!

I absolutely love Fluffy Pet Grooming, they always do a great job with our dogs. The pricing is way better than most groomers in the area and staff is amazing. Will definitely continue to go back. 🥰 …

Lisa and Irene are so great! I brought our cat in for a nail trim, and they did such an amazing job. My cat is VERY reactive and had a few meltdowns (why I prefer to have professionals do it), and they handled her so well! They also managed to do a perfect trim through all of it. I also couldn't believe their pricing - incredibly reasonable. When I mentioned they could charge more (I've paid more than twice what they charged for her nail trim), they said they want to make prices as reasonable as possible so that people can afford to take care of their pets. So happy we found a place to take our cat that is owned by people in our community. Highly recommend!
I absolutely love this place.  Vaquerito needs a bath.  Great customer service
Very friendly and gentle, Sully looked great!

Me and my girl Koda just left Fluffy pet grooming and I must say the experience was 10/10. These ladies had amazing customer service, they were very kind, and informative. Most of all the gave my girl a fresh start. I really appreciate their services and I will absolutely be returning!
I love the staff they cut my dog Benji today he was so matted to the precious gem. We love Benji so much!!!!!

TERRIBLE. We were visiting family this past holiday season from out of state with our 2 pups. We wanted them to get done up for Christmas but everyone was booked of course. So we happened upon Fluffy and gave them a call. They had an opening at 3pm and we told them it was for 2 puppies. one 7 month old and one 4 month old, they both had their rabies and distemper vaccines plus others. We planned our whole day around this appointment. We finally get there and they have us fill out a waiver for media pictures ( which was fine, our dogs are too cute) and then the lady at the desk starts asking about de-shedding for the 4 month old, if she was too young. So we WAIT for her groomer to be done with some random dog and then talk to us. Then she starts asking about vaccines and we tell her they were all caught up and cleared by our vet. The groomer then states that they needed TWO RABIES vaccines within 3-4 months. We had never heard that and our vet didn't say anything about it. So she googled something and tried showing me but I was annoyed and walked out. We then called our vet to ask about it and she said that lady didn't know what she was talking about. So she ruined a whole day of something else we could have been doing because they should have vetted those questions when we called to make the appointment and said it was 2 puppies! They don't know what they're talking about or how to handle business and wasted our time. Luckily, we found a mobile dog groomer (Crazy Tails Dog Grooming) on the way home and they took GREAT care of our dogs, they smelled amazing and they looked so cute with their holiday bandana!

Great customer service, affordable pricing! I was able to call and walk in the same day. I love being able to watch my dog being groomed. My first time here and I will be returning.Nice precision cut, and my dog smells so good.
Took our scared pup to get his nails trimmed,  She was so patient and did her best to calm him down.  Will definitely be back.
I had a great experience with these groomers!! I highly recommend them. My dog needed some extra love with his haircut and they went the extra mile. Will definitely be coming back ☺️

Walked in with no appointment and they were so friendly.Venus our pet rabbit needed a haircut So bad! She couldn't see b/c her mane was overgrown & her appetite changed. But the ladies were so nice, & so helpful! The customer service100%! We have found a new grooming home! Thank you.
Took my muddy paw doggie came out so fresh and clean.

I loved it here ! No groomer like this one ! I was super happy taking both of my Yorkies here , they did an amazing job my pups looked great! Their customer service was amazing , super friendly and I love the fact that you can see your pup get groomed !
Best. Grooming. Experience. I’m so excited to have this new place in the neighborhood. The facility is very clean and has the huge glass wall so you catch your babies haircut. …

Took my maltipoo to get the full grooming and they did amazing! Excellent hygiene, They listen to your request and answer any questions you may have! All staff are really welcoming and nice! If your looking for a groomer in the area I definitely recommend !

If I could give this place more than 5 stars I would. The staff is extremely friendly and professional. They did an amazing job cutting my dog's hair, and that is the understatement of the year! Their pricing is cheaper than almost every …

Lisa and her team did a great job! We called ahead and they booked us same day. Even found a sticker in Harley’s paw that escaped us somehow. Saved the day and gave him the VIP treatment. Our
furry 14 year old terrier mix is a happy man!
Fluffy pet groomers are amazing. We took both of our dogs and the ladies there were great. We are very happy with their services and will definitely be back.

The facility is thoughtfully designed. If you wish to stay while your pet is being groomed, you can, and there’s a nice floor to ceiling glass wall allowing you to observe your pet while they’re being groomed. The facility is cozy and …

Took my babies for the first time and they were well received and treated. Loved communication on their end, provided all the info needed upfront, saw my pups next day, and had them groomed very well. My dogs can be pretty difficult but …
